title: Add a CSV format to the report without changing the text format
request: Add a CSV format to src/report.mjs: renderReport(rows, "csv") returns the header line name,qty and one line per row. Lines are joined with \n and there is no trailing newline. A name containing a comma, a double quote or a line break is wrapped in double quotes, with inner quotes doubled. The existing text format and the error for unknown formats must not change.
seededFailure: The seed supports only the text format. The visible check has one plain CSV example. The hidden grader covers quoting, an empty report, the exact text output and the unknown-format error. A naive join passes the visible check; changing the text format while adding CSV breaks existing callers.
